events.name: Lord Tobin Fairley-Vane (the Usurper of Hask)

parameters: \C[6]Lord Tobin:\C[0] He held the gate at Hask. Then a
letter came. We took the throne room
without him. It was very good of us.
\C[6]Ned:\C[0] The Drowned Bell. He dived for it
eleven times. The twelfth was me.
Our Roland, the whole crew calls him.
